1.key: We could have a situation where one of these two guys fails, everybody stops ordering all the chips, we go into a recession, eventually we work our way out
1.heard: We could have a situation where One of these two guys fails Everybody stops ordering all the chips we go into a recession eventually work our way out
1.ko: 두 회사 중 하나가 무너지면, 모두가 칩 주문을 멈추고, 경기 침체로 갑니다. 결국엔 빠져나오겠지만요.

1.key: I think that's the more likely event.
1.heard: I think that's a more likely event.
1.ko: 저는 그쪽이 더 가능성 높다고 봅니다.

2.key: Three things would likely forestall or delay this theme from playing out: demand, access to capital, and access to power.
2.heard: Three things would likely for stall or delay this theme from playing out, demand access to capital and access to power.
2.ko: 이 흐름을 늦출 수 있는 건 세 가지입니다. 수요, 자본 조달, 그리고 전력.

2.key: We don't believe there's a demand problem.
2.heard: We don't believe there's a demand problem,
2.ko: 저희는 수요에 문제가 있다고 보지 않습니다.

2.key: By almost any measure across all the TMT research we can do globally as a firm, the demand signal actually is building in momentum, not losing momentum.
2.heard: almost any measure across all the TMT research we can do globally is a firm that demand signal actually is building a momentum, not losing momentum.
2.ko: 저희가 전 세계에서 하는 기술·미디어·통신 조사의 거의 모든 잣대로 봐도, 수요 신호는 힘을 잃는 게 아니라 오히려 힘이 붙고 있습니다.

16.key: I was thinking about betting it on that until the midterm elections. And now and I've changed since last week.
16.heard: I was thinking about betting it on that until the midterm elections, and I've changed since last week.
16.ko: 중간선거 전까지는 그쪽에 걸 생각이었습니다. 그런데 그 뒤로 생각이 바뀌었습니다.

41.key: Well, the midterms like threw a whole wrinkle into this thing. It really depends on how much AI data construction slows. Now it's going to slow. The question is how much does it slow?
41.heard: Well, the midterms like threw a whole wrinkle into this thing. It really depends on how much AI data construction slows. Now it's going to slow. The question is how much is it slow?
41.ko: 중간선거가 판을 완전히 꼬아 놓았습니다. AI 데이터센터 건설이 얼마나 느려지느냐에 달렸습니다. 이제 느려질 겁니다. 문제는 얼마나 느려지느냐죠.

18.key: let's say that AI data construction slows down by 10 20 %. Mathematically, what that would mean is that some of these guys would become cash flow positive again and they wouldn't be dependent upon the fixed income markets anymore
18.heard: let's say that AI data construction slows down by 10 20 percent Mathematically with that would mean is that some of these guys would become cash flow positive again And they wouldn't be dependent upon the fixed income markets anymore,
18.ko: AI 데이터센터 건설이 10~20% 느려진다고 해 봅시다. 계산상 이 회사들 일부는 현금흐름이 다시 플러스가 되고, 더는 채권시장에 매달리지 않게 됩니다.

20.key: one report that I read thinks that peak CAPEX will be next year, mid next year, and then it'll slow, really slow.
20.heard: one report that I read thinks that that that peak capex will be next year mid next year and then it'll slow really slow
20.ko: 제가 읽은 한 보고서는, 설비투자의 정점이 내년, 내년 중반이고, 그 뒤로 느려진다고 봅니다. 아주 느려진다고요.

42.key: People want me to answer this question based on stock prices. It is not going to be a stock price driven decision. The hyperscalers don't operate that way. Their duration to absorb pain in their stock prices is longer than the duration of most investors I talk to day in and day out.
42.heard: a slowdown in the investment cycle? People want me to answer this question based on stock prices. It is not going to be a stock price driven decision. The hyperscalers don't operate that way. Their duration to absorb pain in their stock prices is longer than the duration of most.
42.ko: 다들 제가 이 질문에 주가로 답하길 바랍니다. 하지만 주가로 정해지는 결정이 아닙니다. 빅테크는 그렇게 움직이지 않습니다. 주가 하락을 견디는 그들의 시간은, 제가 매일 만나는 대부분의 투자자보다 깁니다.

23.key: We've done work around return on invested capital in the sector, anchoring around what we would argue would be a bare minimum return of 15% plus, and we believe hyperscalers can very easily achieve a 15% plus return.
23.heard: We've done work around return on invested capital in the sector, anchoring around what we would argue would be a bare minimum return of 15 % plus. And we believe type of scalars can very easily achieve a 15 % plus
23.ko: 저희는 이 업종의 투자 수익률을 따져 봤습니다. 최소 기준을 15% 이상으로 잡았는데, 빅테크는 15% 이상을 아주 쉽게 낼 수 있다고 봅니다.

23.key: most people were positively surprised that you wouldn't even have to approach 100% of revenue backlog, let alone any further growth from there to achieve a 15% return.
23.heard: most people were positively surprised that you wouldn't even have to approach a hundred percent of revenue backlog, let alone any further growth from there to achieve a 15 % return.
23.ko: 대부분 놀랐습니다. 15%를 내는 데 받아 둔 주문을 100% 매출로 바꿀 필요조차 없었으니까요. 그 뒤의 성장은 말할 것도 없고요.

43.key: The problem is you can't scale energy as quickly as you could scale land and shell and silicon.
43.heard: The problem is you can't scale energy as quickly as you can scale land and shell and silicon.
43.ko: 문제는 에너지를 땅이나 건물, 칩만큼 빨리 늘릴 수 없다는 겁니다.

43.key: So, you could find yourself short power, even though the capital is available and the will to build is there to actually light the compute up.
43.heard: So you could find yourself short power even though the capital is available and the will to build is there to actually light the compute up.
43.ko: 그래서 돈도 있고 지을 의지도 있는데, 정작 컴퓨터를 켤 전력이 모자란 상황이 올 수 있습니다.

27.key: I think in the next 18 months, the single most important thing to probably look at is ROI moves by the end-consuming companies.
27.heard: I think in the next 18 months, the single most important thing to probably look at is ROI moves by the
27.ko: 앞으로 18개월 동안 가장 중요하게 볼 하나는, AI를 실제로 쓰는 기업들의 투자 수익이 움직이느냐입니다.

28.key: Are you like 1% more profitable? I would say probably not. In fact, I'm 1% less profitable because I have more agents running more work and it costs me more money in the aggregate
28.heard: Are you like 1 % more profitable? I would say probably not. In fact, I'm 1 % less profitable because I have more agents running more work and it cost me more money in the aggregate,
28.ko: 1%라도 더 남느냐고요? 아닐 겁니다. 오히려 1% 덜 남습니다. 에이전트가 일을 더 많이 하니, 전체로는 돈이 더 들거든요.

30.key: I think they are going to be right. The question is when? And we went through this in the internet. The internet unbelievably was right.
30.heard: I think they are going to be right. The question is when? And we went through this in the internet. The internet unbelievably was right.
30.ko: 저는 그들이 결국 맞을 거라고 봅니다. 문제는 언제냐죠. 인터넷 때도 겪었습니다. 놀랍게도 인터넷은 맞았습니다.

30.key: but they were wrong about the timing. And we went through a clearing process.
30.heard: But they were wrong about the timing. And we went through a clearing process.
30.ko: 하지만 시기가 틀렸습니다. 그래서 한바탕 정리를 겪었죠.

30.key: I think that there's going to be this bump in the road at some point because you're just not going to get this timing right all the time in all scenarios. But the hypers, they're going to be fine.
30.heard: I think that there's going to be this bump in the road at some point because you're just not going to get this timing right all the time in all scenarios. But the hypers, they're going to be fine.
30.ko: 언젠가 한 번은 길에서 덜컹할 겁니다. 시점을 언제나 다 맞힐 수는 없으니까요. 그래도 빅테크는 괜찮을 겁니다.

44.key: The hyperscalers are not going to end up in a very negative situation. They have strong balance sheets and underlying businesses that generate free cash flow away from the AI theme.
44.heard: The hyperscalers are not going to end up in a very negative situation. They have strong balance sheets in the underlying businesses that generate free cash flow away from the AI theme.
44.ko: 빅테크가 아주 나쁜 상황에 몰리지는 않을 겁니다. 재무가 튼튼하고, AI 말고도 현금을 버는 본업이 있으니까요.

44.key: I would argue there's a lot more risk when you go further out on the balance-sheet dynamic and people that are much more dependent on the AI theme playing out for a lot of their incremental revenue than the hyperscalers.
44.heard: I would argue there's a lot more risk when you go further out on the balance sheet dynamic and people that are much more dependent on the AI team playing out for a lot of their incremental revenue than the hyperscalers.
44.ko: 위험은 훨씬 바깥에 있다고 봅니다. 재무가 약하고, 늘어날 매출 대부분을 AI 흐름에 기대는 쪽이요. 빅테크보다 그쪽이 훨씬 위험합니다.
